scope: Seven current role sections: owner, staff, candidate (desktop and mobile), and platform administration. Action annotations, link placeholders, competitor analysis and historical drafts are excluded from screen counts.
coverage_note: Inventory and reference availability are evidence of inspection, not a claim that every frame is implemented or visually verified. The role sections contain 354 screen/state frames.
external_blocker: Figma MCP stopped further exports: Full seat / Professional plan tool-call limit reached. Complete visual verification requires restored access or a current design export.

implemented_areas.area: Role navigation and mobile profile menu
implemented_areas.details: Figma SVG icons, fixed mobile navigation, accessible profile drawer, results and authorized workspace links.
Four owner steps, three staff steps, two learner steps; per-user completion; restart from Help.
Mobile card sizing and stacking; original optimized Figma assistant artwork; real API metrics retained.
Mobile person cards, visible active tab, account-created dialog with temporary credentials and assignment link. No email required.
Catalog tabs, metadata/progress/source dialog, assignment links and explicit deletion confirmation.
Compact mobile cards, separate course-only view, real graded and pending responses, retry eligibility and read-only historical assignments.
Readonly detail cards, explicit edit/cancel/save, horizontal mobile tabs, email and account security flows retained.
Full notification page; searchable role FAQs; support request with durable draft and server reference.

unit_tests.environment_note: Local Node 26 exposes experimental Web Storage; CI uses Node 24.

verification.build: npm run build passed for platform and admin; existing large-chunk warnings remain

live_dev_api_review.mode: Local frontend with live DEV API; login followed by read-only GET requests. Not a deployment.

verification.mobile_active_tab_followup: At 393px, the selected Candidates tab spans x=266..373 after fonts load, within the 20px page gutters.

remaining.reason: The Figma quota prevented exporting and checking every screen/state, especially the full administrative, billing, integration and mobile edge-state sequences.
The current user model has a single organization_id. A real membership/switching API is required before implementing the multi-organization design.
No certificate issuance/download flow is implemented. The new results screen shows actual scores without simulated certificates.
The user-facing API accepts a support request and returns a reference. The full customer conversation/history shown in Figma needs a separate read/reply contract.
The current course catalog accepts draft/published filters. Operator-side archiving exists; owner archive/restore requires an authorized API and explicit assignment/version behavior.
The prototype describes creating/editing on desktop. The current functional editor remains accessible on mobile; the exact desktop-only gate is not implemented in this change.
Results load from up to 24 assignments on the current page. Pagination is labeled; global course/result statistics require an aggregate endpoint.
